title: Stock
subtitle: What you hold, where, and what it's worth.

adjust.title: Adjust stock
adjust.body: Enter the physically counted quantity; the difference is posted against the adjustment location.
adjust.unitCostHint: Required if the count is higher
adjust.incomplete: Choose an item, a location and a counted quantity.

transfer.title: Transfer stock
transfer.body: Move quantity between two internal locations. Value is unchanged.
transfer.incomplete: Choose an item, both locations and a quantity.

itemStock.title: Stock
itemStock.empty: No stock on hand for this item.
itemStock.unavailable: Stock is unavailable for this item.

onHand.empty: No stock to show for this scope.

locations.subtitle: Your internal stock locations. Virtual counterparties are managed by the system.
locations.name: Name
locations.noBranches: No branches exist yet — a location must belong to a branch.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this location?
deleteConfirm.body: "{{name}}" will be removed. It must hold no stock first.

errors.locationBranchDefault: This is a branch's default location and can't be deleted.
